subject: Cascade Tech — SIG control mapping, evidence custodians & delivery plan
messages:
From: Emma Wright <emma.wright@cascade-tech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: security@cascade-tech.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Initial SIG questionnaire handoff and custodian routing

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking the SIG questionnaire. We're putting together our internal control validation plan and want to align on who at Redwood will be the point people for each control family (Access, Change Mgmt, Logging, Data Protection, etc.).

Key asks to start:
- Can you confirm named custodians for the control groups in tab "ControlOwners" of the attached SIG_Questionnaire_Cascade_V1.xlsx?
- We need a simple evidence manifest (csv) enumerating example artifacts you can provide, the expected filename, and the delivery mechanism. I've attached our template (evidence_manifest_v2.csv).
- Please indicate whether evidence will be uploaded to the Drive link below or shared via secure S3 presigned URLs, and whether you'll provide MD5/SHA checksums and access logs.

Target timeline: initial custodian list and manifest by EOD Tue 2028-06-20; full artifact packet by 2028-07-05. If any of that is unworkable please propose alternatives.

Link to our folder (write access granted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CascadeSIG

Cheers,
Emma Wright
Security Program Manager
Cascade Tech

Attachments: SIG_Questionnaire_Cascade_V1.xlsx, evidence_manifest_v2.csv

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wright <emma.wright@cascade-tech.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG questionnaire handoff and custodian routing

Emma — thanks for the clear asks. We'll own this and scope deliverables as below.

Quick answers up front:
- Delivery mechanism: primary will be the shared Drive folder you provided. For high-sensitivity items (KMS proofs, key material screenshots) we will provide presigned S3 links with time-limited access.
- Checksums & logs: we can include MD5 checksums and an access-log extract for each upload.

Assigned custodians (will update the "ControlOwners" tab momentarily):
- Access control & MFA evidence: kimberly_park@redwood.ai (IAM team lead)
- Change management (deploy approvals, release notes): mina_haddad@redwood.ai (release manager)
- Network & infra diagrams, segmentation: jonas_weber@redwood.ai (platform security)
- Logging & monitoring samples: kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Proposed artifacts to map to your manifest:
- IAM policy exports (JSON) — example filename: rw-iam-202806-access-policies.json
- Deployment runbook and RFCs (PDF) — rw-release-RFC-<date>.pdf
- Network diagram (PDF) — redwood_network_diagram.pdf (attached)
- KMS rotation log excerpt (CSV) — rw-kms-rotations-2028Q2.csv
- Sample app logs (redacted) — app-logs-sample-202806.tar.gz

Next steps / schedule:
1) By Mon 2028-06-18 we will populate ControlOwners tab and return an initial evidence_manifest_v2.csv with the artifact mapping.
2) Quick 30-min walkthrough on Tue 2028-06-19 @ 10:00 AM PT to confirm expectations. Please confirm that slot or propose another.
3) Delivery of first artifact batch to Drive by Tue 2028-06-20 EOD.

I've attached the network diagram and will upload the manifest once we complete internal curation.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wright <emma.wright@cascade-tech.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG questionnaire handoff and custodian routing

Adding details from the release & evidence ops side —

Emma / team,

A few practical notes so the manifest and uploads are audit-ready:
- File naming convention: <redwood>-<artifact>-<YYYYMMDD>-<env>.ext (e.g., rw-release-RFC-20280617-prod.pdf)
- Each manifest row will include: artifact name, owner, control reference(s) (SIG question id), checksum (MD5), upload path, snapshot timestamp, and retention category.
- For KMS proofs we will provide a redacted export plus a GCP/AWS console screenshot of the key metadata (key id, creation date, rotation policy).
- Sensitive logs will be redacted for PII and provided as hashed extracts; we will include the hash algorithm and the sample size in the manifest.

If you need immutable evidence (object-versioning required) let us know and we can enable versioned S3 buckets for those files. Otherwise Drive with access-log export is the path of least resistance.

I'll take point on the change-management artifacts and will populate the manifest for that bucket by EOD 2028-06-18.

—Mina Haddad
Release Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

From: security@cascade-tech.com <security@cascade-tech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG questionnaire handoff and custodian routing

Thanks Jonas / Mina / Kimberly — this plan looks good and the proposed cadence works for us. A couple of small asks before the walkthrough:

- Please include MD5 checksums and a CSV of S3 presigned URLs for any artifacts delivered that way.
- For Drive uploads, include an access-log extract showing the upload event and the uploader's account.
- We would like a short table (1-2 rows per artifact) indicating whether the artifact is the authoritative evidence for the control or a supporting artifact. That will speed our review.

We can meet Tue 2028-06-19 at 10:00 AM PT as proposed — Emma and I will be on the call. If you prefer a different platform for the walkthrough (Zoom vs Google Meet) let us know.

Also: please attach the completed evidence_manifest_v2.csv in reply so we can pre-seed our tracker.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Cascade Security Team
security@cascade-tech.com

Attachments: none in this reply.
